title: Kyocera Ceramic Kitchen Knife 150mm
description_en: Kyocera's zirconia ceramic blade is 10× harder than steel and never needs sharpening for everyday use. Ultra-light, odor-free, and rust-proof — the ideal knife for fruits, vegetables, and boneless meats.
description_ja: ジルコニア製セラミック刃はスチールの10倍の硬度。日常使いでは研ぎ不要。サビない・においがつかない・軽い。野菜や果物のカットに理想的。
